title: Project Model Setup Workflow
trigger: New project model creation or initial setup milestone
entry_conditions: An approved project template and project information context are available.
Applicable coordinate and workset governance is known or explicitly unresolved.

steps.action: Create the model from the approved template.
Apply project information and identity fields.
Verify coordinate alignment and publish the check evidence.
Create required worksets from the governed registry or project-defined source.
Assign protected worksets and applicable lock or protection rules.

outputs: Project model initialized from approved template
Applied project identity and information fields
governance_notes: The source identifies Workset Registry and Model Registry as applicable registries and a Template Registry as future support.
This workflow coordinates setup; detailed Revit execution belongs in L6 instructions and configurations.

provenance.migration_note: Source workflow W1.1 migrated from the workflow catalogue. Future registry references were preserved as notes rather than invented as governed objects.
